programmes.funder: Tamwilcom (formerly Caisse Centrale de Garantie), Fonds Innov Invest
programmes.amount_note: Pre-seed grant of up to MAD 200,000 to help project holders move from idea to proof of concept, delivered through accredited support structures (incubators and accelerators) rather than directly by Tamwilcom.
programmes.deadline_note: Applications go through accredited incubators and accelerators, each with its own intake calendar.

procedure_steps.detail: Identify an Innov Invest accredited support structure (incubator or accelerator).
The structure screens and submits the file to Tamwilcom.
Grant approval and milestone disbursement through the structure.

eligibility.other_note: Moroccan project holders and very early startups; the company may be created during the programme.

programmes.source_snippet: The Innov Invest Fund backs innovative startups with financing solutions tailored to every stage of their development, from pre-seed through growth.

programmes.amount_note: Honour loan (prêt d'honneur) or convertible instrument of up to about MAD 1 million for innovative Moroccan startups after proof of concept, again channelled through accredited support structures and partner investors.
programmes.deadline_note: Rolling through accredited structures and Innov Invest partner funds.

procedure_steps.detail: Complete a proof of concept (often via Innov Idea).
Apply through an accredited support structure or partner fund.

eligibility.other_note: Moroccan-registered innovative startups with a validated proof of concept.

programmes.name_en: Tamwilcom guarantee and co-financing for innovative startups
programmes.amount_note: Tamwilcom guarantees a share of bank financing and co-invests through the Innov Invest seed and venture funds it capitalises. Guarantee coverage and ceilings depend on the product; there is no single published figure for startups.
programmes.deadline_note: Rolling, through partner banks and Innov Invest fund managers.

procedure_steps.detail: Approach a partner bank or an Innov Invest fund manager.
The bank or fund submits the guarantee or co-investment request.

eligibility.other_note: Moroccan companies; the guarantee is requested by the lender, not directly by the startup.
